'''Ursods''' were quadrupedal, polar predators of [[Yavin 8/Legends|Yavin 8]] that preyed upon [[songbuk]]s. The fur of the Ursod could change color from white to mottled colors in order to blend in with its changing surroundings.<ref name="GG2" />
